svg.title: Open proposals: two checks can stop one, an objection cannot, and all of them are kept
svg.desc: A proposal carries a hypothesis, an action, a size and a forecast. It passes two barriers that can stop it: facts, and feasibility. A strategy objection is pinned to it and does not stop it. Published, refused and unpublished proposals all go to the method record. From that record, payoff and forecast score are read on two separate axes, and a frozen prospective trial runs three arms from the same starting capital, with missing marks left visible. Nothing is promoted and no order is placed.

text.tspan: A different strategy can still be a valid proposal.
Code checks facts and authority. The model owns the hypothesis.
ONE PROPOSAL ON ITS WAY TO PUBLICATION
pinned on; does not stop it
READ THE TRACK RECORD ON TWO AXES
A call can be right and lose money. The two are never merged.
A missing mark stays a hole in its arm.
Evidence for human review: no automatic method promotion, sizing or order placement.
